title: SG-4 · Remove admin ExecutionPanel UI
summary: Delete ExecutionPanel and everything in the admin UI that renders it or calls the execution, approve, retry and reject endpoints
description: Context: Worldseed must not contain development automation. The admin console in game/frontend still renders ExecutionPanel and calls /api/v1/admin/executions endpoints through game/frontend/src/api/client.ts. Desired behavior: ExecutionPanel.tsx and its tests are deleted, AdminApp and the API client no longer import, render or call anything execution-related. Expected result: remaining admin and game UI tests pass and tsc --noEmit passes. Why: the repo keeps only the game, contribution intake, round lifecycle and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo, when game/frontend/src/components/ExecutionPanel.tsx is looked up, then it does not exist and no test file imports it
Given AdminApp is rendered with a valid token, when it loads, then it requests no URL under /api/v1/admin/executions and renders no execution panel
Given the frontend, when npm run test and npm run typecheck run, then both pass

in_scope: frontend tests and fixtures for the above
preserve: Token gate, round create/open/close controls, world title, contributions list, 401 handling for round calls

technical_constraints: UI-only change in game/frontend; no backend or API change
definition_of_done: AdminApp and client free of execution references
